            cells = []

                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):

                                and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append(cells)

    asymmetric = []
    for cells in components:
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
